where: Proposition 2.1, first line: 'une variété projective lisse purement de dimension paire 2n'
scan: purement de dimension paire 2n ('paire' underlined, '2n' not)
tex: \underline{une variété projective lisse purement de dimension paire} $2n$
corrected: \underline{une variété projective lisse purement de dimension impaire} $2n+1$
note: Authorial slip rather than a typing error; the TeX keeps the printed reading. The statement needs hyperplane sections H_s of dimension 2n (Ev(H_s) ⊂ H^{2n}(H_s, ℚ_ℓ); reflections x ↦ x − (−1)^n(x δ)δ on p. 332), so dim X = 2n+1, as in Théorème 1.4 (p. 330: 'purement de dimension 2n + 1', whose irreducibility statement is announced there to be extended in n° 2). Remarque 2.2 then extends the result to 'X de dimension paire'. The editor may prefer a note to a silent correction.
